newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Corp B up 5.26 pct on water bid win.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp B up 5.26 pct on water bid win.

text.p: Ayala Corp B shares gained 1.50 pesos, or 5.26 percent, to 30 pesos in early trade on Friday on news that it won one of the contracts in the privatisation of the Metropolitan Water and Sewerage System (MWSS), brokers said.
"Its euphoria over the results of the MWSS bidding," said Teresa Lee, assistant vice-president at Lippo Securities.
Ayala Corp A shares also rose by 75 centavos, or 3.13 percent, at 24.75 pesos apiece in early trade.
"There are fewer B shares available so with the higher demand of foreign investors, we can see bigger gains on B shares but A shares should catch up," said Spencer Yap, analyst at BPI Capital Corp.
After 20 minutes, a total of 822,500 Ayala B shares were traded while 375,400 A shares changed hands.
